display_long_description:
# Trace the constellations and fill the night sky with vast nebulae.
# Host online stargazing events using your own astrophotos and the real sky at your observing location.
# Use passthrough to instantly understand where stars, planets, and deep-sky objects are located around you.

Trace constellations, fill the sky with vast nebulae, and instantly locate celestial objects with passthrough.
Display constellation lines and 10 wide-field nebula regions at their actual positions, revealing how stars, constellations, and enormous nebula complexes are connected.

Deep Sky Finder’s LIVE feature combines your astrophotos with the sky at your observing location. Replace default Messier images with your own photos, then host an online stargazing event for Quest users.

Participants see the host’s sky at the same location and time, view custom photos at the objects’ true positions, explore the Milky Way and wide nebulae, and send Good! reactions.

Passthrough overlays stars, constellations, planets, the Sun, Moon, and Messier objects onto your surroundings, making sky learning and observation planning simple.

Deep Sky Finder brings together passthrough sky guidance, wide-nebula exploration, and shared online stargazing in one app.
